# Multimediary

> A personal physical media library management system for cataloguing DVD, Blu-ray, and HDD movie collections with TMDb metadata integration.

Multimediary is a private collection browser — not a streaming service or commercial platform. It helps one person catalogue and browse their physical movie library. All movies listed are physical media titles (DVDs, Blu-rays) stored on HDDs.

## Public Pages

- [Home](/): Hero carousel of featured movies, browse by genre/category, and collection stats
- [Movies](/movies): Full catalogue with filter by genre, category, year, and text search
- [Movie Detail](/movies/{id}): Full movie info — synopsis, cast, director, ratings, disk location, file size
- [Actors](/actors): Browse actors who appear in the collection
- [Actor Detail](/actors/{id}): Actor profile with full filmography from the collection
- [Directors](/directors/{id}): Director profile with filmography from the collection
- [Categories](/categories): Browse movies by category (Movies, TV Series, etc.)
- [Category Detail](/categories/{id}): All movies in a given category
- [Genres](/genres): Browse movies by genre (Action, Drama, Thriller, etc.)
- [Genre Detail](/genres/{id}): All movies in a given genre
- [Disks](/disks/{id}): Physical disk inventory — all movies on a specific HDD or disc

## What This Site Is Not

- Not a streaming platform — no video content is served
- Not a public movie database — only titles physically owned by the operator
- Not open for public registration — admin panel is private

## API

A read-only public JSON API is available at `/api/v1/public/`. Key endpoints:
- `GET /api/v1/public/movies` — paginated movie list with Ransack filtering
- `GET /api/v1/public/movies/{id}` — full movie detail
- `GET /api/v1/public/actors` — actor list
- `GET /api/v1/public/stats` — collection totals and top genres
- `GET /api/v1/public/search?q={term}` — cross-resource search
